cues.text: Every spell. Every tier. Every word of every schedule, including the ones I haven't read. The tenth tier and all beneath it, everything, at once.
The cost is assessed immediately. Your soul is reduced to... nine percent.
I'm required to characterize that figure. At nine percent the world stops agreeing with you.
You'll hear things that are speaking and things that aren't. Stones won't stay where it's put. Curses attach without cause and leave just the same.
It isn't survivable in the sense you mean and it isn't fatal in the sense you mean either.
